tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid kyi chos nyid dngos ston zhes pa'i nyams len nyung bsdus bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i brgyud 'debs skabs kyi smon lam las/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /ces pa'i don cung zad gtan la 'bebs pa la sems kyi gzhi rtsa ngos bzung ba/ de'i rgyun skyong ba dang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sems can rnams kyi sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de nyid gzhi dus kyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sam nges don gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin dgos te/ kye rdor las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib// ces 'byung bas so// de ltar yin pa la yin par ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis gzung 'dzin gyi yul la chags te 'khor bar sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong ba yin la/ gzung 'dzin zhes pa'ang sems dang sems byung las ma 'das te/ gzung ba ni sems dang gcig 'dzin pa sems byung dang gcig par mdzad pas/ dper na dngos po bum pa lta bu mig gis mthong nas/ bum pa'o snyam pa ni gzung ba yin la/ bum pa'i lto ba mgrin pa sogs la zhib tu rtog pa de 'dzin pa'o// de ltar sems gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas bslad kyang sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba zhig rang chas su yod la/ de nyid la gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'am/ rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar na/ rgyud gsum du 'jog pa las rgyu'i rgyud ces bya ba de nyid do// de'ang gnyug ma ni dper na dgon par gnas pa'i dge 'dun rgyun bzhugs la yang gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun zer ba ltar don sngar nas rang 'bab tu yod pa'i tshig yin la sems nyid kyang mtshan nyid gsal ba/

rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer med pa gdod ma nas lhun grub tu yod pa la gnyug ma zhes ming btags pa'o// rgyu'i rgyud ces pa ni sems de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir dang sems can gyi blo'i rtogs pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes mdzad pa 'phrin las sogs kyi bar du sems kho rang snang zhing rgyun ma chad par gnas pas na de la rgyud ces bya'o// sems gsal rig stong gsum de'i ngo bo la ltos nas gnas 'gyur med la/ rnam pa la ltos nas gnas 'gyur yod pa ste/ dper na rgyu zangs gcig la gcin gyi snod bum pa gcig dang*/ spos phor gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gcig ste gsum bzos pa'i gnas skabs na/ rgyu zangs kyi ngo bo de ka ma gtogs 'gyur rgyu spu tsam mi 'byung yang*/ rnam pa'i dbye ba gcin snod de la skyug bro ba dang*/ spos phor de la gtsang sred pa dang*/ sku de mchod pa'iganas su 'jog pa sogs 'byung ngo*// dpe de bzhin du sems kyang dmyal ba nas sangs rgyas kyi bar la don dam pa'i ngo bo la bzang ngan du song ba med kyang kun rdzob tu 'khrul snang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig longs spyod pa'i tshe 'khor ba pa zhes bya/ bla ma'i man ngag gis dri ma cung zad srab nas de'i rgyun la gnas pa na lam zhugs chos pa zhes bya/ dri ma mtha' dag spangs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas zhes khyad par tsam byas pa yin no// de yang kye rdor gyi rgyud tshig gong gi 'phror/ de bsal nas ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces 'byung bas de bsal nas ni zhes pa de bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ glo bur gyi dri ma sbyong byed lam rnam par dag pa ma 'khrul bar nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa rgyud la shar ba ni lam gyi rgyud ces bya ba nyid do// lam des spang bya mtha' dag spangs/ thob bya ma lus pa thob ste dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku mngon tu gyur pa ni 'bras bu'i rgyud ces bya ba de nyid do// rgyud gsum po de rang sems kho na la tshang ba yin no// gnyis pa sems nyid gnyug ma rgyu'i rgyud de lam dang*/

'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i sa la 'khyol ba la lta sgom spyod gsum gyi lam gyi gnad phyin ci ma log par nyams su len dgos/ de'ang thog mar lta ba ni 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems las 'byung gi gzhan log na med par thag bcad dgos te/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rin chen sems las phyir byung gi /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces so// sems de nyid kyi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas pa'i tshe na/ dang po yul 'di nas/ dbyibs 'di 'dra/ dus 'di tsam nas skyes bya ba mi 'byung bas dang por ma skyes bar du rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus kyi phyi nang*/ des mtshon pa'i snod bcud 'khor 'das 'di 'dra zhig la gnas zhes bya ba dang*/ dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ma 'di'o zhes btsal kyang mi rnyed pas bar du gnas pa med/ de ltar skye ba dang gnas pa med pas mthar de la ltos pa'i 'gags pa'ang mi 'grub ste/ dus 'di tsam na 'di 'dra zhig tu sems 'gag nas 'gro zhes pa lta bu mi rnyed pas/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral zhing*/ des mtshon yod med phyogs 'dzin rtag chad sogs mtha' bzhi dang bral ba zhig tu nges pa rnyed pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa de don bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la bslab dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas nas// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces so// de bsgom pa la gnad gsum dang ldan dgos te/ 'khrul 'khor lus kyi gnad/ lta stangs mig gi gnad/ bzhag thabs sems kyi gnad do// dang po la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bya ba ste spyi dang 'dra'o// bsgom la gegs 'byung ba phal cher lus gnad la skyon zhugs pas yin te lus mdun du gug na/

shes pa 'phyo zhing rnam rtog 'khrug gdon du rgyal po gnod/ nad snying rlung sogs 'byung*/ mthar smyon par 'gro nyen yod de/ tshul de bzhin du lus gnad kyi skyon thams cad la rigs 'gre'o// lus rnam snang gi chos bdun tshul bzhin bcas pa la yon tan dpag tu med de/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung gis thur sel gyi rlung dbu mar tshud/ nyon mongs phrag dog zhi/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs/ de bzhin du lag pa mnyam bzhag sogs lus gnad bca' tshul bdun po re re la yon tan skye tshul re re yod pa rigs 'gre'o// de yang rnam snang ni phung po lnga'i nang tshan gzugs phung rnam dag dug lnga'i nang nas gti mug sbyong byed/ rigs gsum gyi nang nas sku rdo rje/ ye shes lnga'i nang nas me long ye shes te gnas 'gyur sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin gcig tu nges la/ gzugs phung ni phung po gzhan thams cad kyi brten gzhi/ gti mug ni nyon mongs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ sku rdo rje ni rigs thams cad kyi gzhi'am/ me long ye shes thams cad kyang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na 'o// zhes pa'i tshul gyis ye shes thams cad kyi gzhi ma ste/ mdor na lus gnad nyid nyams len gyi gzhi ma dang rtsa bar bstan pa'o zhes kha cig gsungs te de yang mi 'thad par mi sems mod/ bla ma gong ma dag lus gnad de nyid rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i bzhugs stangs dang 'dra ba las rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes bya'o gsungs/ gnyis pa lta stangs mig gi gnad ces pa ni/ sems gnad rlung*/ rlung gnad rtsa/ rtsa gnad mig la yod pas mig btsum pa dang ha cang bgrad pa sogs ma yin par sna rtser phab pa'am/ yang na gnya' shing gang tsam gyi sar thad kar ha re lta'o// gsum pa bzhag thabs sems gnad ni/ sgom yong du re ba/ ma byung gi dog pa sogs mi bya bar zol med du lhod kyis klod nas ma yengs par dran shes kyis zin par byas te 'jog pa'o// de yang dper na chu rnyogs ma can dwangs su re nas bcas bcas mang nas slar rnyog mar 'phel zhing*/

rang babs su bzhag pas myur du dwangs 'gro ba dang 'dra ba yin no// de ltar sgo gsum rang lugs su bzhag pa de'i goms pa dpyis phyin pa'i mthar rnam rtog phra rags thams cad zhi nas sems rang babs su gnas pa'i stong cham me ba zhig la rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung ste rig shes la dwangs cha med na de zhi gnas steng po zhes bya ba yin pas ting nge 'dzin rnam dag ma yin/ de kho na la zhen na mthar mi rtog pa'i nyams kyi gzugs med khams su 'phen no// de la rig pa dpangs bstod de dran pa'i ngar dang bcas te rgyun bsrings nas bsgoms pas sems kyi ngo bo gsal le hrig ge ba mdor na gsal cha bden 'dzin dang bcas pa'i nyams skye zhing*/ de sems kyi mtshan nyid rags pa'i ngo bo tsam mthong ba yin mod kyi/ da dung sgom rnam dag tu mi 'gro gsal cha de la zhen na gzugs khams su 'phen no// de la sems la sems kyis yang yang lta ba'i tshul dang lus gnad kyang cung zad khong klod/ lta stangs smad/ shes pa klod nas rang babs su cham me bzhag pas/ ji zhig nas gsal stong zung 'jug gi nyams dpe nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu brjod med kyi bde ba lhang gis skye/ bde nyams de la zhen na 'dod pa'i khams kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pas nyams la ma zhen par gsal stong 'dzin med kyi rig pa blo 'das yul can gnyis med kyi ngang du bzhag pas mdo ltar na/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin skyon med skye ba yin la/ sngags ltar na thabs khyad par can gyis zin par byas pas bde chen lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa skye'o// de yang zhi gnas kyi dus sems byings rgod dang ma bral bar dran shes gnyen po'i tshul du bsten pa kho na gal che ba dang*/ byings rgod dang bral nas rnam rtog gang shar la bzo bcos ma song bar de kha'i thog tu lhod klod nas 'jog shes pa gal che'o// de'i tshul mdor bsdus na/ dper na/

mi zhig gis rang la tshur brlag thod khyod zer byung na/ de la zhe sdang drag po skyes nas phar de'i lan du ngan smras sogs byed na tha mal pa dang khyad med/ zhe sdang de la bzod pa bsgom pa sogs gnyen pos spangs na rnam rtog gis rnam rtog spang bar 'gro/ de ye shes yin/ chos sku yin snyam pa lta bu byas nas bsran btsugs pa na blos byas kyi rgyas 'debs byas par 'gro/ zhe sdang gi rnam rtog de kho rang gi thog tu bzo bcos ma byas par klod nas sems la sems kyis lta ba'i tshul du bzhag pas zhe sdang gi rtog pa kho rang gsal stong zung 'jug tu rjen lhang nge shar ba de nyon mongs pa ye shes su 'char thub pa sngags kyi dgongs pa'o// dpe de bzhin nyon mongs rnam rtog thams cad la rigs 'gre'o// de goms pa mthar phyin pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba de rgyud la skye'o// de dag la gegs sel tshul bogs dbyung tshul/ lam gyi drod rtags 'char tshul rnams ma 'khrul bar so so'i don la mkhas par byas nas nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa spyod pa'i rim pa'ang de ltar sems kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba sems can rnams la rang chas su bzhugs kyang tshul de ltar yin pa ma shes pa'i dbang gis 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa rnams la byams snying rje bsgom zhing ci byed sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*/ bde sdug 'byor rgud sogs chos brgyad kyi rtog pa gang shar la spang blangs med par bzang ngan ro snyoms shing bde ba chen po'i lam du khyer nas byed pa ni spyod pa'i gnad dam pa'o// de ltar nyams su len pa'i dus na thog mar sems kyi gnas cha ma rnyed bar la zhen log skyo shas gnad che bas dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs yang yang bsam pa gal che'o// gnas cha cung zad rnyed nas rlung sbyor dang dmigs pa sna tshogs la sbyong ba sogs lta ba'i bogs 'byin byed pa gnad che'o// lta ba la go myong cung zad rnyed na byams snying rje rtsal 'don byas te thabs shes ya bral du ma song bar byas pas bogs 'don dang lam gyi chod che zhes rje bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal las thos so// de ltar nges don gyi gdams pa'i snying po cung zad spel ba 'di'ang mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbye ba med pa'i skyes mchog rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i sprul pa'i sku don grub rgya mtshos bka' stsal spyi bos nos te zhwa lu sprul ming pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis tshar chen yab sras kyi bzhed srol ltar snying po khol byung tsam du mgyogs par bris nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig

ces pa 'di'ang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la mngon sum du reg pa grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pha bla ma bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag byang gling pa mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la dpal zhwa lu ri phug gi sgrub khang rnam grol yang rtser dgyes pa chen pos bka' drin du stsal ba'o// de yang rje de nyid kyi zhal nas/ spyir deng sang dus snyigs mar song*/ tshe yun thung*/ shes bya rnam grangs mang*/ ji ltar byas kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa ni dka' bas/ bstan rgyud dang rang rgyud la phan nges kyi dbang lung nyan bshad re tsam ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs sogs phar zhog rang dbang byung na gdul bya zang zing bsdu ba/ thos bsam tsab tsob byed pa/ 'chad nyan gyi 'du longs bsgrub pa sogs gang la'ang gzhan mgo skor khyad las dgos pa med/ mdor hril gyis dril na/ nam 'chi cha med bsam nas tshe 'di blos btang*/ ngo srung dang 'gras 'dris spangs/ mchog dman gang la'ang re dog mi bya/ tshe 'di la zhen pa can gyi rigs dang lta spyod mi bstun/ grub mtha'i phyogs zhen bskyur/ rang tshod rang gis bzung nas mtshams bsnyen bsgrub byas byas kyi kha khral 'jal 'dod tsam min par nyams len gsha' ma zhig la rgas rgas 'chi 'chi'i bar snying por dril ba 'thad ces yang yang gsungs so// don med 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i bya bzhag dang*// don nyams chos ltar bcos pa kun spangs nas// don dam nges gsang zab mo'i lam 'di la// don ldan rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson par shog /ces pa'ang snying thag pa nas smon lam du btab pa de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i gegs sel khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i thugs thig bzhugs so//

༈ /dran pas gdung sel rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbyer med mkha' spyod dbang mor gus btud de// zab mo'i lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don tshul// snying po mdor bsdus dam pa'i gsung ngor bshad// 'dir zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i snying po rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa nyams su len pa la lam gyi gegs sel tshul bla ma'i man ngag ltar bshad par bya ba la gnyis te/ gegs sel gyi ngo bo cung zad spros te bshad pa dang*/ bogs 'don zhar byung du bsdus te bshad pa'o// dang po la/ gegs 'byung ba'i rgyu brtag pa/ rkyen brtag pa/ gegs kyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa/ de mi 'byung ba'i thabs su sgo dgag pa/ byung na phyir bcos pa'i thabs so// dang po rgyu la ring rgyu ni ma rig pa'i 'khrul shes te/ de ni chos kyis sel dgos pas spyir btang ngo*// dmigs bsal nye rgyu la gzhan dbang dang*/ ltar snang gi rgyu gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni tshe rabs sngon ma nas bsod nams kyi bsags rgyab chung ba dang*/ nag po'i sa bon 'thug pa'i rkyen gnyis 'dzom gyis chos kyi las 'phro med pa thos bsam bsgom gsum gang byas kyang tshabs su mi 'gro ba zhig byung te/ de ni skal ba dman par gyur pa zhes bya ba bcos kyang dka' ba zhig ste shing lu 'dzer can la brkos mi thebs pa dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa ltar snang tsam gyi gegs 'byung ba'i rgyu brtag pa la gnyis te/ rang gi bsam spyod kyi rgyu byed pa dang*/ rten 'brel gyi byed pa'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bdud kyi bar chad ni shes rab chung zhing brtson 'grus che ba las 'byung bar rigs par bya'o// zhes gsungs te de yang shes rab yod na gegs 'byung yang bcos sla ste mkhas pa'i ltung ba lci yang yang zhes pa'i dpes mtshon/ brtson 'grus med na gegs mi 'byung ste nyal nas sdod pa la bsgom gyi gegs 'byung na dud 'gro la yang 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de la dang po ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan ldan gyis ma zin par dpe cha la bla ma bcol ba dang gcig

dpe cha la bla ma ma bcol kyang bla ma mdzo pho 'dra bas slob ma mdzo pho 'dra ba 'khrid nas phyin pa dang gnyis/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan ldan gyis zin yang bsten yun thung bas nyams len bya rgyu'i chos la thos bsam gyis phu thag ma chod par the tshom skye ba'i gzhi mang ba dang gsum/ rang gi blo'i go ba gti thug pas chos la gdeng ma 'khyol bzhin du brtson 'grus tsab tsub kyis nyams len byed pa dang bzhi po 'di shes rab chung ba la brten pa'i gegs 'jug pa'i rgyu ste de lta bu ni go ba lug las chung ba la u tshugs glang las che ba zhig byas nas khe 'ong ba med pa dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa ni thos bsam gyis phu thag chod kyang lus zungs stobs chung ba dang*/ khams ngan pa dang*/ snying tshan med pa dang*/ blo stobs kyis mi chun bzhin du phral blo rgod kyi dbang du btang*/ mi la ras pa sogs grub thob kyi dka' spyad rnam thar la dpe blangs te/ gcig pur sdug rus dang nyams len la 'jun drag po byed pa rnams ni brtson 'grus che ba la brten pa'i gegs kyi rgyu ste/ de lta bu ni mdzo khal ra la bkal bas che chung 'dzol thebs te mthar ra bsad nas sdod dgos pa dang 'dra'o// gsum pa ni shes rab dang brtson 'grus kyi cha nas 'grigs kyang kun slong ngan pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres nas chos byed pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur snyan grags la re ba dang*/ thun mong gi mngon shes dang grub rtags la re re dog dog dang bcas lhag bsam log pas chos nyams su len pa yang gegs kyi rgyu ste/ de lta bu ni rtsa ba thang khrom nag po yin pa la 'bras bu a ru ra yin snyam du bsgoms nas zos kyang smyo nas yong ba dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa rten 'brel gyi byed pa ni/ sngar bla ma la chos zhu dus bla ma la mnyes pa tsam gyi rkyen 'ga' zhig byung ba dang*/ rang la ma dad pa'i rtog pa sna tshogs shar ba dang*/ chos la the tshom za ba dang*/

gdams ngag bka' rgya can la yon ma phul bar sus thob kyis zhus pa dang*/ bla ma'i chos dus kyi tshogs gtor dgos pa ma phul ba dang*/ gsang dgos pa'i lha dang gdams ngag dpe cha sogs snod min la spros te bshad pa dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma bsten nas rten 'brel log pa'i byed pa mtha' yas te 'dir smos su mi lang bas/ de lta bu ni gegs bar chad kyi rgyur 'gro ste lho brag mar pas nā ro ta pa la phyag 'tshal lugs nyes pa tsam gyis phyis sras dar ma mdo sde'i mgo bo chag pa bzhin no// der ma zad rang gi sngar sdig pa chen po 'ga' zhig byas pa ma dran pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa dang sdom pa la skyon byung ba la sems kyis ma tshor ba dang*/ gzhan ma'i skye bo dam sdom nyams pa'i grib can dang 'grogs pa dang*/ de dag dang lhan cig chos zhus pa tshun chad kyi gegs 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gro ste/ de lta bu ni rims nad kyi bag 'gos zin nas khang pa'i phug tu bros nas bsdad kyang mi phan par nges par na yong ba dang 'dra'o// gegs kyi rgyu brtags pa'i skabs so// gnyis pa rgyu de slong bar byed pa'i sad byed kyi rkyen brtag pa la/ gong gi rgyu de dag la yang rkyen ci rigs tshang mod kyi bye brag tu gnas dang gcig lag g.yog dang gnyis/ dgra gnyen gyi mthun 'jug dang gsum/ gnad log pa dang rang gi blo gti thug pa'i rkyen no// dang po ni/ gnas mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pas dgra log pa dang*/ bdud rigs kyi lha klu drag po gnas pa dang*/ na tsha 'jug pa'i sa chu mi 'phrod pa yod pa dang*/ mi rgod dam skye bo mi bsrun pas gang ba dang*/ chos la mi dga' ba'i rgyal po sogs kyis bdag byed pa dang*/ 'du 'dzi dang sems bying rgod kyi dbang du 'gro ba'i gnas gang du bsdad kyang gegs rkyen byed de/ dpe nor bu ngom nas rkun ma yod sar sdod pa dang 'dra'o// de lta bu ma yin kyang sde 'khrugs sogs sa tshig pa'i gnas su'ang yon tan mi skye zhing gegs rkyen du 'gro bar bshad pa yod do// gnyis pa lag g.yog sam grogs ngan pa tha snyad la dga' ches pa dang*/

rang dang blo mi mthun pa dang*/ kha mang ba dang*/ khog pa gyong ba/ spu sur la spra 'tshal che ba dang*/ tha na'ang rtse mo dang kyal ka'i slad du bsdigs ri gtong ba tshun chad kyis gegs 'jug pa'i rkyen byed pa yod de/ sngon byung khams pa sga lo rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon pas rtswa mi lo tsā dang mjal zhing khong gnyis po 'khrungs sa khams par song ba dang*/ khyad par rtswa mi rgya gar na mkhas grags che bas chos zhus/ sga lo la lto gos chos gsum gnang ste rdo rje gdan du bsgrub pa la bcug go /der mtshams dam po la yod dus bug sgor grogs mched ā tsa ra gcig 'phrad par 'ongs/ khos sga lo bos pas lan ma byung bar/ kho re khyod nga la lan mi zer 'dug kyang pha tshad na du ru ka'i dmag yong gin 'dug go zhes bsdigs ri btang bas sga lo khong skrag pa'i rkyen gyis khams 'dus zhugs nas smyo ba rgya gar du'ang ma sel bar bod du ā tsa ra bzhi bskyel du btang ste sa chen kun dga' snying pos gegs sel mdzad pa'i gtam rgyud yod do// bsgrub pa gsha' ma zhig rang byed na gcig pur sdod pa gal che zhing sngon gyi dam pa gong ma rnams sku mtshams dam po mdzad dus mtshams tho rim pa gsum rgyag zer ba'ang gnad cig yod 'dug go /de ltar ma 'grub tshe g.yog mi bsten pa'i thabs rang med na bdag cag gi chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chen pos mkhan po gdan sa ba la bka' chems su gsungs par/ g.yog po sreg sreg mang po/ las ka mi yong ba/ bza' ba yong ba/ 'bul ba btsal nas mi 'ong ba/ kha smras btsal nas yong ba/ cha rkyen khyer nas mi 'ong ba/ god kha khyer nas yong ba/ gtam snyan khyer nas mi 'ong ba/ gtam ngan khyer nas yong ba/ de lta bu'i g.yog po 'khor du mi bzhag pa gal che/ gzhag na gud gzhan ye ma byung na'ang*/ lo gcig la zan stong brgyad cu/ bya sna dang bcas pa 'chor ba yin pas/ de 'dra mi gso ba gal che/

zhes gsungs pas 'di chos mdzad dam/ mi mdzad pa 'jig rten gyi bla dpon rigs la'ang gnad chen po 'dug cing*/ de ltar ma byung na chos kyi nyams len gyi gegs rkyen 'jig rten gyi bla ma dpon po la mi 'byung mod kyi/ phral sku rlung 'phar rkyen byed pas gzab dgos pa yod do// gsum pa dgra gnyen gyi mthun 'jug ni/ dngos su dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi shom ra byas na chos kyi gegs rkyen byed pa lta ci smos/ chos byed dus dgra 'dul rgyu byung na dga' ba la snyam pa tsam gyi gegs rkyen du song ba yod de/ sngon byung dge bshes klong thang pa bya ba zhig khams kyi char pho rgod po nor phyugs po yod pa gcig gi bur skyes/ khong rang gi pha shi bab nor thams cad pha spun nye 'brel rnams kyis 'phrogs te bu tsha 'di yul du bzhag na lan byed du 'ong zer klong thang pa kho rang yul nas bskrad do// khong gi dbus gtsang du yong nas chos byas shing*/ brtson 'grus dang shes rab che bas la stod rtsibs ri sogs su bsgrub pa kho na la sgril gnyid 'od gsal du tshud/ chos gos kyis gshog pa byas te/ nam mkha' la 'phur thub pa tsam byung ba yin 'dug go /lan gcig nyin mo'i rnal 'byor skyong dus ri zhig gi rtser phyin nas sdad yod pa'i skabs su mdun na mar ri bya mang po'i khyu chen po 'phur 'gro ba mthong ba'i rkyen gyis/ khong gi rnam rtog la bya khyu chen po 'di rnams skyes bu go cha gyon pa sha stag tu song nas nga'i yul gyi dgra thams cad chom thub na dga' ba la snyam pa shar/ des gsos btab nas zhe sdang skyes/ lam gtong ma byas pas gegs rkyen du song*/ gegs ci byung na phyis khong gi yul du phyin nas chos kyi bsam sbyor las log dmag dpon byas te sus kyang ma thub par dgra thams cad bsad nas dmyal ba'i me nang du nag ting nge song ba'i gtam rgyud yod do// gnyen gyi mthun 'jug ma spangs pa'i thabs rang med de phral de dag dang 'brel byas pas gegs rkyen mi byed 'dug snyam du yod kyang nam zhig bdud rigs kyi bar gcod brtsam pa 'di dag gis bsam pa bsgyur nas gegs rkyen byed pa yod de/

chos byas na 'jig rten gyi pha ma sogs bsod nams kyi zhing yin zer nas gus pas ngag nyan pa yod dam/ dgos pa khyad par can yod na ma gtogs sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la byung ba'i shed bu ser skya'i gtam rgyud dran dgos pa yod do// gzhan yang bla ma mang po la chos zhus nas/ de thams cad la dad pa dang mos gus ni bya dgos pa yin mod/ bla ma gcig gis bstan pa'i chos nyams len bya 'phro dang dgongs pa skyong 'phror/ gcig gi yang de ltar byed pa lta bu ni gegs rkyen du 'gro ba srid de sngon byung khro phu ba'i dge bshes bsod nams bzung bya ba jo nang du zhang kun spangs pa thugs rje brtson 'grus la sbyor drug gi khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas nyams myong cung zad skyes/ bla mas mnyes po mdzad/ de 'phror yang pa gnam bsam sdings su shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub la ni gu chos drug zhus/ der jo nang du chos zhus pa'i nyams myong 'di 'dra skyes/ bla mas 'di skad gsung*/ ji lta bu lags zhus pas/ mkhas btsun pa na re/ zhang kun spangs pa'i gsung de 'dra ga na yin pa/ de la 'di dang 'di lta bu zer ba yin zhes grub mtha' tha dad kyi chos skad bshad pas/ dge bshes de blo 'gyur zhang kun spangs pa la dad pa log mkhas btsun pa la tshad mar bzung ste ni gu chos drug bsgom pa yin rung mi gtsang pa kha nas skyugs te shi ba'i gtam rgyud yod do// bzhi pa gnad log pa'i gegs rkyen ni/ ma nges pa sna tshogs zhig 'byung mod kyi/ de dag gi ngos 'dzin che long tsam brjod na rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye las/ de la gnad rnams 'chos pa'i bdud// la la sangs rgyas dngos su ston// kha cig mkhan po slob dpon dang*// bla ma'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dang*// pha ma'am nye du'i cha lugs kyis// sems can rnams ni bslu bar byed// 'ga' zhig rtsub mor smra byed cing*// bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis bsgyur bar byed// la la 'jam por smra byed cing*// byams pa'i tshul gyis bslu bar byed// la la sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i lung*// phyin ci log tu bshad nas bsgyur// la la rigs pa bzang po la// ngan pa yin zhes bshad nas bsgyur// la la rigs pa ngan pa la// bzang po lta bur bcos nas bsgyur// la la zas nor ci 'dod pa'i// rngan pa byin nas chos log ston// la la lus dang sems la ni// ting 'dzin cung zad bskyed nas ni// de las yid ches skyes pa dang*// log pa'i chos ni bstan nas bslu// la la mngon par shes pa dang*// rdzu 'phrul cung zad bstan nas kyang*// blun po yid ches bskyed nas ni// phyis nas chos log ston par byed// la la nga yi 'di ltar bsgoms// de la rtogs pa 'di skyes pas// khyed kyang 'di ltar gyis shig ces// rang gi nyams myong yin pa yi// tshul du byas nas log par ston// mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*// phal cher mthun par ston byed cing*// gnad rnams log par ston pa'i chos// legs legs 'dra bar ston na yang*// bdud kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes// mdo rgyud kun las gsal bar gsungs// zhes dang*/

'di 'dra'i rigs kyi bdud rigs 'ga'// mi 'am 'phags pa'i gzugs bzung nas// log pa'i bstan pa 'phel ba'i phyir// chos dang bsres nas gnad rnams su// chos log bsres nas 'chad pa srid// dper na kha zas bzang po la// sbyar ba'i dug gis phal cher gsod// dug rkyang yin par shes na ni// 'ga' yang gsad par nus ma yin// de bzhin chos bzang 'ga' zhig la// chos log bslad pas phal cher bslu// chos log rkyang par go na ni// 'ga' yang bdud kyis bslu mi nus// ri dwags rnga ma ma bstan na// bong sha 'tshong bar mi nus ltar// de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na// log pa'i chos kyis bslu mi nus// bdud kyi byin rlabs thams cad kyang*// ngan pa kho nar nges pa min// 'on kyang bzang po'i nang nas ni// gnad rnams cung zad bcos pa yis// phan pa lta bus pha rol bslu// 'di 'dra shes par byas nas ni// chos kyi gnad rnams mdo rgyud bzhin// ma bslad par ni legs par bzung*// shing rta'i srog shing chag gyur na// 'khor lo bzang yang 'gro mi nus// srog gi dbang po 'gags gyur na// dbang po gzhan dag bya byed med// de bzhin chos kyi gnad 'phyugs na// chos gzhan bzang yang nus med gyur// rdzogs sangs rgyas las mkhas pa yi// gang zag 'jig rten gsum na med// des na de yis gsungs pa yi// mdo rgyud rnam par dkrug mi bya// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don la dpyad cing rgyu mtshan ma go na/ bdud kyi byin rlabs sna tshogs dang*/ rang gi blo gti thug pa gnyis thabs shes kyi tshul du song nas gegs rkyen byed pa yod do// gegs kyi rgyu rkyen bshad zin to// gsum pa gegs kyi ngo bo la spyir chos bsgrub pa la nyon mongs pa'i bsam pa drag po skye ba tshun chad gegs kyi ngo bo yin mod kyi/ 'dir gsang sngags kyi lam bsgom pa ni/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom tshul log pas lus sems 'khrugs pa zhig dang*/

ting nge 'dzin gyi byed las rang byung gi nyams sogs skyong ma shes par rigs sngags log pa'i sbyor ba lta bu'i gegs sogs so// bzhi pa de dag mi 'byung bar bya ba'i gnad ni/ rgyu rkyen de rnams ngos bzung ste spang thub par bya ba ste/ de las gzhan du gegs mi 'byung bar bya ba'i thabs mang yang nyi tshe tsam du 'gro'o// lnga pa bcos thabs la bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po/ bskyed rim la sems 'dzin sogs la 'bad par ma byas pa'i lha'i rnam par wal le ba blo yul du byas nas sngags bzlas pa zhig la ting nge 'dzin gyi tha snyad med/ de 'dra la gegs sel bogs 'don dgos na deng sang gi ser ba srung mkhan rnams la'ang ci'i phyir mi dgos/ ser ba srung mkhan gyis kyang lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas tshul de tsam zhig bya dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na bskyed rim la sems 'dzin kho na gtso bas sems 'dzin gyi gegs ni bsam gtan gyi dug ces bya ba de yin no// 'dir rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa gal che ba de spyan dbus ma yin/ de la dper mtshon na gsal thabs gsum ste bsgom pas gsal 'debs pa/ brjod pas gsal 'debs pa/ bltas pas gsal 'debs pa'o// dang po ni/ spyan dbus ma dbus gnag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba gcig dpral ba'i dkyil du bsgom ste/ de'ang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ 'phro bcad kyang rnam pa wal wal byung na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas bum pa'am/ snam bu ka ba sogs dngos po gzhan la yengs su bcug yang sngar bzhin bsgom la bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ste/ de'i tshe spyan dbus ma bsgom kyang mi gsal la/ spyan gzhan ma sgom kyang gsal ba 'byung ba de 'dra'i rjes su mi 'brang bar rtsa ba'i dmigs pa kho nar btsal lo// gnyis pa de ltar byas nas bsgoms pas kyang gtan gsal cha ma rnyed na brjod pas gsal btab pa zhes bya ba/

thog mar rang gi kha nas spyan dbus ma dbus gnag pa zhes sgra dag pa cig brjod la bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung gin bsgom/ de lta bu yang yang byas kyang mi gsal na grogs gzhan cig la spyan dbus ma dbus gnag pa sogs gong gi tshig bslab nas brjod du bcug de nyan gyin bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung gin bsgom/ gsum pa de ltar byas kyang mi gsal na bltas pas gsal btab ste/ shog bu la spyan dbus ma shin tu mdzes pa gcig bris pa la bltas te bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung gin bsgom/ gal te des kyang mi gsal na spyan dbus ma rang gi mdzod spu'i thad du mtshams pa gcig bris la sbyar/ mdun du me long dwangs pa gcig shing la btags te de la bltas shing bsgom/ ma bsgom kyang gsal gsal 'dra na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas shes pa gzhan la yengs su bcug de ltar bsgom pas spyan dbus ma gsal bar 'dod pa de'i tshe gsal cha rtag tu byung na lha so so'i dag pa ru slebs pa yin/ yang gsal 'phro la med par 'dod nas med par bya bar nus na/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ru sleb/ de dag la brten nas zhi gnas kyi nyams khyad par can skye ba ni rang rig pa'i dag pa ru sleb pa'o// de ltar spyan dbus ma la dag pa gsum gyi ye shes brtan nas spyan g.yon/ g.yas sogs dmigs pa spos la rim pas sems 'dzin no// de dag gi dus su res 'ga' ni dmigs pa gsal ba 'byung*/ res 'ga' ni mi gsal ba sogs 'byung yang dga' sdug gi rnam rtog bcas bcos dang*/ rnam g.yeng dang*/ sgyid lug gi dbang du ma shor ba bya/ mdor na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis/ thab 'og gser bum yod pa ma shes pas// dbul phongs sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgan mo bzhin// rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po bzhugs bzhin du// rgya 'byams 'khrul pas nyen pa nyon re mongs// da ni mchog gi bla ma'i sku drin gyis// 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po rang gi sems// brjod bral rang ngo shes pa'i dpal 'byor gyis// snang srid rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig tu song*// go yul tsam 'dis g.yang sa mi chod pas// ma yengs dran pas bzung la nyams su long*// pha yi thugs dang rang sems gcig gyur pa// de tshe bla ma'i sku drin 'khor ram snyam// zhes pa ltar sems la dga' sdug gi rnam rtog byung na lta thog tu bzhag

yang sngar bzhin 'phro mthud nas bsgom/ mdor na ye shes tshogs bsags kyi don gsal stong gi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du sngar gyi sems bskyed kyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par shar ba bsgom pa ni zab gsal gnyis med kyi bskyed rim zhes bya ste/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam 'khrul med du lugs 'di'i bla ma gong ma dag bzhed la/ de goms pa'i stobs kyis snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid de ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta ba'i nyams myong skye zhing*/ 'od gsal gyi rtags lnga mnyam rjes gang rung du mthong bar 'gyur la/ de mthong ba'i gang zag de gang zag gnyis par 'phos pa yin no// da dung sngar bzhin goms pa'i stobs las bde stong zung du chud pa sogs gang zag gsum par 'phos pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung*/ de tsam na gnas sbyongs dang khams 'dus pa sogs kyi 'phrang gegs ci rigs pa 'byung zhing*/ de dag byung rgyal du lam gtong bar byas pas gang zag bzhi par 'phos pa'i mtshams te/ 'dir yi dam lha'i zhal ston pa sogs 'byung*/ de la brda bstan pas bzlog tshul gsungs pa las/ brda ni dbang bzhi'i brda ste/ lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan te bstan// zhes pa'i don la lag g.yon gyi sor mo lnga nang du bsdus/ g.yas pa'i gung mo dang mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan te/ g.yon du bskor zhing yid kyis dris/ de ni bum dbang gi brda rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ bdag po'i dbang dang drug gi brdar go ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig /ces pa'i don/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin mgrin par reg la yid kyis dris/ gsang dbang brdar shes shing lan thebs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya ste// zhes pa'i don/ g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yas kyi spar bar bcug pa snying gar bzhag la yid kyis dris/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang brdar lan thebs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa'o// zhes pa'i don bstan pas dbang bzhi pa'i brdar don go ba'o// brda 'di dag bka' rgya shin tu dam pas ji bzhin du yi ger 'bri mi rung mod/ 'dir cung zad bstan pa zhib tu brda chig brgyud kyi skabs su bla ma las thob par byed dgos so// de ltar dbang gsum pa'i brda las bzhi pa ma shes na bdud/ shes shing lung ston na dngos grub ci yang med na mthong snang tsam yin pas bzang ngan med par byung rgyal du btang ngo*// gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin kho nas brtags pa ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos gzugs mthong ba de la ye shes pa spyan drangs te bcug pas de 'phral yal na bdud/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas na lhag pa'i lhar ngos bzung bar bya zhing*/ yang na zhal ston po de ma yin pa'i yi dam gzhan gcig tu lam gyis bsgoms pas gnas bsgyur la de'i sngags bzlas pas/ lad mo dang 'gyur ba bstan na bar chad rtsom pa'i bdud/ 'gyur ba gtan med na dngos grub kyi lha'o// snying po rab 'byed las/ gal te dngos grub 'byung gyur kyang*// ngo mtshar byed na bdud yin no// gal te bar chad byung gyur kyang*// dgos med shes na dngos grub yin// zhes so// mdor na phar phyin theg pa'i lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo ni zhi lhag gnyis yin la/ 'dir bskyed rim bsgom pas zhi gnas dngos su skye zhing*/ lhag mthong shugs kyis skye ba ni/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// sogs kyi khyad chos yin pas las dang po pa la sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa skyong tshul/ bying rgod sel tshul sogs thos bsam gyis phu thag chod par byas te bsgom na gegs byung yang de bcos tshul nyams kyis shes nas don 'grub par gsung*/ de tsam zhig ma gtogs bskyed rim kho na la rtsa gegs rlung gegs sogs rgyu med la 'bras bu 'byin mi srid do// gnyis pa rdzogs rim la nyams len gyi ngo bo rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnad du bsnun tshul ma shes pa'i gegs dang*/

shes nas bsgom pa la rang byung gi nyams ngos ma zin pa'i gegs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa khyim dang 'dra/ thig le nor dang 'dra/ rlung bdag byed kyi mi dang 'dra/ zhes pas gegs 'jug pa'i sne 'dren/ rlung bzung nas sems g.yeng ba dang*/ rlung rngubs tshul ma shes pa dang*/ dus min la rlung 'dzin nyes pa dang*/ lus gnad la skyon shor ba ci rig pas byed mod kyi gtso bor rtsa bsgom ma shes par gnad 'khrul ba kho nas byed/ de la rtsa la dbye na bye ba phrag bcu/ de bsdus na nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ de bsdus na stong phrag bdun cu don gnyis/ de bsdus na sum cu so gnyis/ de bsdus na ro rkyang dbu gsum/ de bsdus na dbu ma gcig pu la 'du bas 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa dbu ma'i skabs su dbu ma ngos 'dzin rgyu de/ kha cig srog pa rtsa la ngos 'dzin/ de bsgom pas rlung sems srog rtsar 'dus nas smyo ba la sogs pa'i gegs 'byung*/ kha cig gzhung pa la ngos 'dzin/ de la dbu ma'i chos bzhi ma tshang*/ kha cig dbu ma gnas lugs la med par 'dod pa sogs 'khrul tshabs shin tu che'o// rang lugs ni/ phyag thig las/ srog gi dbyu gu'i nang na gnas// sum cu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan// phra ba'i phra ba mang dag phra// phyi rol ma yin nang ma yin// zhes srog pa rtsa shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu'i 'od kyi rang bzhin can thog reg dang bral ba yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhin zug pa 'chi ba'i tshe dbugs dang bsdong nas yal 'gro ba zhig yod/ de'i nang na dpe tsandan sbrul gyi snying po la bshad nas/ tsandan gyi nang khog pa na sbrul yod pa ltar srog rtsa'i nang na dbu ma chos bzhi ldan yar sne tshangs bug gi rus pa'i steng sha'i nang na zug pa mas sne slob bshad pa'i bzhed pa ltar na lte ba'i gnyer po che'i 'og tu zug par 'dod/ gzhan phal cher gsang gnas la zug par 'dod do// de la rtsa mdud drug yod pa las/

spyi bor chos 'byung lta bu'i rtsa mdud/ mgrin par gzhon nu ma'i nu ma lta bu'i rtsa mdud/ snying gar mig lta bu'i rtsa mdud/ lte bar padma rgyas pa lta bu'i rtsa mdud/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa bar rdo rje rgya gram lta bu'i rtsa mdud nor bu'i rtse mor til gyi me tog lta bu'i rtsa mdud dang drug go /ro rkyang gnyis kyang srog pa rtsa'i nang na yod/ mdud pa drug gi thad du srog pa rtsa phug ste rtsa 'dab gyes nas yod par gsungs so// dbu mar rlung sems 'dus pas yon tan 'ba' zhig skye la/ srog pa rtsar rlung sems 'dus na gegs chen po 'byung ngo*// gnas lugs kyi dbu ma ngos 'dzin rgyu med pa dang*/ ngo ma 'phrod na rtsa dbu ma bsgom pa'i lam thams cad sgrog btags tsam du gyur nas dmigs pa bsgom kyang yon tan mi skye nyes pa skye ba'o// gang zag 'ga' zhig la rtsa sbom pa mthug cing hrem pa rtsa mdud mang ba sogs yod na sems rgyud zhe sdang che/ blo rang bzhin sgam pa yod/ rlung sgom pas gegs byung na bcos dka' na tsha zug gzer che ba yong*/ rtsa 'khril ba dang rtsa sna 'dzings pa sogs yod na sems rgyud rmongs shing gnyid rmugs shas che/ blo rang bzhin lhod pa tsam yod/ gegs byung na bcos dka' sla 'bring*/ na tsha sogs kyang 'bring*/ rtsa mdud nyung zhing phra ba/ rtsa sna mang ba sogs yod na sems rgyud 'dod chags shas che/ rang bzhin sems srab la blo rgod pa tsam yod/ gegs byung na bcos sla/ na tsha dang gzer zug kyang chung*/ mdor na yon tan skye ba'i gnad thams cad dbu ma dang*/ gegs 'byung ba'i gnad srog pa rtsa la yod pa'o// de lta bu'i dbu ma ngos zin cing lus gnad la skyon ma shor ba byas te bsgom pas gegs mi 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa rtsa yi ge la rgyas par phye na bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ mdor bsdus a ka tsa ṭa la sogs pa'i yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bdun du 'du/

de bsdus na pū dza la sogs pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'du/ de bsdus na a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug tu 'du/ de bsdus na rigs lnga'i sa bon yi ge lngar 'du/ de bsdus na 'bru gsum du 'du/ de bsdus na lte ba'i a thung ngam bam̐ yig nyid la 'du'o// spyir 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad skyed pa'i sa bon kun gzhi'i rnam shes la bag chags kyi tshul du gnas/ de'i sa bon lus la rtsa yi ge'i rnam par gnas pas/ rtsa gnas su rlung sems 'dus pas yi ge 'jig rkyen gyis gnas sbyangs la sogs pa'i nyams kyi 'char sgo sna tshogs 'byung ngo*// gsum pa khams bdud rtsi la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ mdor bsdus na khams sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de bsdu na khams dgu/ de bsdu na lus zung bdun/ de bsdus na bdud rtsi lnga/ de bsdus na byang sems dkar dmar gnyis/ de bsdus na dkar po gcig pu la 'du'o// thig le'i gegs ni rtsa gnas su khams snyigs ma 'ju ma thub par 'khar ba'i nad dang zug zer ldang ba dang*/ khams 'dzags pa'i gegs gnyis las de dag gi gnyen por lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor dang*/ 'dzag bsrung bsten pa sogs bya ste/ dwangs ma zhu nas rtsa la khrems na bde ba kho na skye bde ba dang stong pa zung du ma chud pa rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs ma byang pa'i rkyen gyi phyir 'dzag pa'o// bzhi pa snying po rlung la phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor bsdus na las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'du/ de yang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcur 'du/ de yang ldang 'jug gnyis sam/ srog rtsol gnyis sam/ steng 'og gi rlung gnyis su 'du la/ gegs 'jug pa'i rkyen yang 'dzin gtong ma shes pa dang*/ sems g.yeng ba las 'byung ngo*// 'dir cung zad zhib tu smos na rlung bcu po re re la yang*/ ming dang*/ gnas dang*/ byed las dang*/ kha dog dang*/ zin pa'i rtags dang*/ rengs pa'i skyon dang*/

bcos pa'i thabs te don bdun du yod la/ de la dang po ming la dbye na rtsa ba'i rlung lnga la/ me mnyam/ srog 'dzin/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ thur sel te lnga la rim pa bzhin 'byung ba dang sbyar nas/ sa rlung*/ chu rlung*/ me rlung*/ rlung gi rlung*/ nam mkha'i rlung zhes zer ro// de bzhin du yan lag gi rlung lnga yang 'byung ba dang sbyar na gong du ma 'dus pa med mod kyi/ bye brag ming gi dbye ba rgyud sde spyi lugs la/ rgyu ba sa rlung*/ yang dag rgyu ba chu rlung*/ mngon par rgyu ba me rlung*/ rab tu rgyu ba rlung gi rlung*/ shin tu rgyu ba nam mkha' rlung zhes zer ro// yang dus 'khor nas ni/ klu dang gtsang sbal rus sbal dang*// lhas byin dang ni nor las rgyal// zhes pa'i ming mi 'dra tsam gsungs so// gnyis pa gnas dang gsum pa byed las sbrags nas bshad na/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga las/ me mnyam lte ba na gnas/ pho ba'i me drod skyed cing zas skom 'ju byed kyi las byed/ srog 'dzin snying ga na gnas/ srog 'dzin cing dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i las byed/ gyen rgyu mgrin pa na gnas/ mchil ma 'dor ba dang smra dgod kyi las byed/ khyab byed spyi bo dang sor tshig la gnas/ lus mgul bskyod kyi las byed/ thur sel gsang gnas na gnas/ dri chu sdom 'byed kyi las byed do// yan lag gi rlung lnga'i gnas tshul rgyud sde spyi lugs ni rgyu ba mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog kha bye ba lta bu la gnas nas gzugs mthong byed kyi las byed/ yang dag rgyu ba rna ba'i dbang po gro ga bcus pa lta bu la gnas nas sgra thos byed kyi las byed/ mngon par rgyu ba sna'i dbang po zangs kyi khab gshibs pa lta bu la gnas nas dri tshor byed kyi las byed/ rab tu rgyu ba lce'i dbang po zla ba bkas pa lta bu la gnas nas ro myong byed kyi las byed/ shin tu rgyu ba lus kyi dbang po reg na bde ba'i pags pa lta bu la gnas nas reg bya tshor byed kyi las byed do// yang dus 'khor nas ni/

klu zhes pa rgyu ma klu'i pho brang lta bu la gnas pa sogs gsungs so// bzhi pa kha dog ni/ sa rlung kha dog ser po/ chu rlung dkar po/ me rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung sngon po/ nam mkha'i rlung ljang gu ste rlung gi kha dog rang bzhin la gnas pas rlung gi yon tan cung zad skyes nas 'byung 'jug sna sgor byed pa la yun ring du goms pa'i stobs kyis mthong ba yin gyi/ rang gar ci rung rung gis mdog mthong ba sogs mi 'byung ngo*// lnga pa rlung de rnams bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis zin pa'i rtags ni/ rlung bcu po de rnams rang gnas su zin pa'i rtags dang*/ dbu ma kho nar zin pa'i rtags gnyis las dang po la/ sa rlung rang dgar zin na pho bi sbo 'ur sgra 'byin/ lte ba'i 'khor lor zin na ting nge 'dzin bde stong yun thung ba zhig skye/ du ba lta bu'i nyams 'char/ chu rlung rang dgar zin na snying 'phyo zhing 'khrug stod gzer zhing na/ snying ga'i 'khor lor zin na stong gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin yun thung ba zhig skye/ smig rgyu lta bu'i nyams 'char/ me rlung rang dgar zin na lkog ma tsha zhing 'thab/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lor zin na ting nge 'dzin shes pa gsal la rtog pa med pa skye/ srin bu me khyer lta bu'i nyams 'char/ rlung gi rlung rang dgar zin na mgo bo dang yan lag gi tshigs rnams gzer zhing na/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su zin na ting nge 'dzin lus bde stong rjen par 'char/ mar me sbar ba lta bu'i nyams 'byung*/ nam mkha'i rlung rang dgar zin na bshang gci 'gro 'ong gi bar du tsha zhing gzer/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor zin na ting nge 'dzin bde stong yun ring ba zhig skye/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams 'char ro// yan lag gi rlung rnams kyang rang dgar zin na mig la sogs par na zug 'byung*/ gzhan phal cher 'dra'o// gnyis pa dbu ma kho nar zin pa'i rtags ni/ dus 'khor las/

'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur// de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag la rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste// re khā nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar 'gyur gyi bar du 'o// zhes pa ltar gyi nyams rtags 'byung bar bshad do// drug pa rengs pa'i skyon tshul la/ de yang rkyen bzang ngan ci rigs kyis sa rlung mi nyams pa'i rlung phyir rgyu ba nang du log pas pho ba'i gnas su rlung ro ci bsags kyi nad du gyur pa ste skran dang rmu chu sogs su 'gyur la de lta bu byung na mi nyams pa'i rlung rengs pa'o// de bzhin du srog 'dzin chu rlung phyir rgyu ba nang du log pas rlung rengs 'byung ste snying rlung sogs su 'gyur/ rlung rengs thams cad kyi nang nas srog 'dzin gyi rlung rengs pa nyid skyon che'o// gyen rgyu'i rlung rengs pas kha lkug pa dang lkog 'bras sogs 'byung*/ khyab byed kyi rlung rengs pas za 'phrug dang yan lag rengs 'khum dang mdze 'brum sogs lpags nad sna tshogs 'byung*/ thur sel gyi rlung rengs pas ro smad bshal cing mi theg rtsa chu 'gags pa dang*/ gyen log gi nad 'byung*/ yan lag 'byung lnga'i rlung rengs pas mig sogs sgo lnga'i dbang shes 'khrul ba dang mi gsal ba 'on long sogs 'byung ngo*// mdor na rtsa thams cad kyi nang nas srog rtsa rlung thams cad kyi nang nas srog 'dzin ni gegs 'byung ba'i gtso bo yin no// bdun pa bcos thabs la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga sogs rengs pa'i sger bcos dang*/ rtsa rlung spyi'i gegs bcos thabs snying por dril ba gnyis las/ dang po la srog 'dzin gyi rlung rengs pas snying 'phyo zhing sems mi dga' ba la gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas bsal te/

rang gi snying sgo nga khog pa stong pa lta bur gsal la/ de'i nang du khyim stong du zla ba shar ba ltar/ gang nas byung cha med par 'od dkar po gsal seng nge ba reg bya bsil ba grangs sing nge ba zhig bsam ste/ thun ci rigs pa bsgom pas zhi'o// skabs su stod bsengs/ sgreg pa 'don no// yang snying 'phyo zhing sems mi dga' ba la bsal thabs bzhi ste/ dang po lte ba'i ram̐ las me 'bar bas snying thul thul tshig par bsam la rlung phyir 'bud pa dang ha gang rigs bya/ gnyis pa snying lte ba'i 'og dmar ba song nas yod par bsams la rlung ro phyir 'bud/ gsum pa snying rgya mtsho'i gting du mar song ba yang yang bsams la rlung ro phyir 'bud pa dang ha gang rigs bya'o// bzhi pa rang gi spyi bo'i steng du thod pa mar khus gang ba la/ mar khu'i rgyun babs pa spyi bo nas zhugs te snying ga yan chad khengs par bsam mo// gzhan yang snying ga'i dkyil du bla ma dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i zhal ras can mtshon gang pa gcig bsgom la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo// de dag gis ma phan na sna'i rtse mo las khrag phyungs te sna rtse mnyed na yang phan par bshad do// stod la gzer sogs byung na sna g.yas bkag ste/ g.yon nas rlung drag tu phyir 'bud pa yang yang bya'o// me mnyam kyi rlung rengs la/ rlung shugs bskyed nas phyir gtong ba dang*/ nang du 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba yang yang bya zhing rkang pa brkyang bskum dang 'gro ldog sogs bya/ thur sel gyi rlung log rengs la/ rkang pa gnyis sgrims te brkyangs shing mgo bag tsam g.yom g.yom bya/ yang rkang pa bskums la de lta bu yang yang bya ba dang*/ 'gro 'dug mchong rgyug sogs lan 'ga' byas pas kyang phan pa yod do// gyen rgyu'i rlung rengs la/ lag pas lkog ma mnye zhing rkang pas yang yang bcag rlung sna gnyis nas drag tu yang yang 'bud/ khyab byed kyi rlung log rengs la chu bzang dus yin na chur zhugs/

de min lus la rang gi dri chu dron mo yang yang byugs la gos dron mos byibs te phyi nas gser bu ma shor bar rlung bum pa can ci thub 'dzin/ yan lag gi rlung lnga'i nang nas rgyu ba rengs pas mig na ba dang mi gsal ba byung na ltag khung du shes pa gtad la mig 'byed 'dzum yang yang byed pa dang*/ yang smin mtshams su shes pa gtad la der bug pa gsum brtsegs sam/ 'od dkar po sran ma tsam la sems bzung ste rlung phyir drag tu 'bud cing thub tshad nang du 'ong du mi gzhug pa yang byas pas mig nad gang la yang phan par gsungs/ gzhan bcos thabs rnams lam 'bras kyi gegs sel dang gzhan las 'byung ba rgyas bkab ste nyams su blangs pas chog par sems so// gnyis pa rtsa rlung spyi'i gegs bcos thabs la lus gnad 'khrul 'khor la skyon spong ba rtsa rengs sogs mi 'byung ba'i gnad dang*/ rlung bsgoms pa'i sngon du lus la sku mnye dang byugs pa bya zhing drag shul gyi spyod lam mi bya ba ni rlung rengs mi 'byung ba'i gnad do// rlung cung zad goms nas rtsa rengs dang rlung rengs 'dul ba la lam 'bras kyi phrin las so gnyis lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor shes nas rtsa rlung gi gegs dang lus kyi nad sogs thams cad la mi phan pa med pas nyams su blangs/ gal te mi shes kyang yan lag lnga sbyong lta bu'i lus sbyong shes nas mi bya ba'i thabs med pa ste/ lus sbyong ci yang ma byas par rlung bsgom pa la ni dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams rlung mdze yong zhes gsung ngo*// 'khrul 'khor la nā ro chos drug pa'i lugs kyi 'khrul 'khor nga drug ces rgyas pa dang*/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa bya ba bsdus pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyor drug dang*/ ni gu chos drug sogs rdzogs rim kyi khrid bka' che ba phal cher nas 'khrul 'khor yod pas de dag rtsa rlung spyi'i gegs sel sha stag yin la/ rlung 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba yang bum pa can dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa sogs phal cher dgongs pa mthun pas 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rdzogs rim bsgoms pa'i tshe yang rang gi 'khrul 'khor lag len gang shes pa gcig nyams su blangs na chog go

/da lta'i bka' brgyud pa'i rtogs ldan phal cher rnams kyis rlung sgom 'di dag phal cher ni dbang gis ma smin par byin rlabs tsam gyis chos sgo phye ste nyams su len pa mang la/ gtum mo bsgom pas rten rtsa nang gi dwangs ma zhu nas rlung sems la bde bas khyab ste brten pa rig stong dbyer med du byed pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad mi shes pas mu stegs kyi rlung sbyor dang khyad par med mod/ 'on kyang lus la drod tsam skye ba dang gegs chen po mi 'byung ba ni lus sbyong 'ga' re ma 'khrul bar byed shes pa byung la/ de'i yon tan yin par shes so// lus sbyong 'ga' re yang byed mi shes na rtogs ldan rnams kyi rlung 'dzin tshul 'di 'dra ba ni dbugs nang du sdud shes pa tsam du zad do// las dang po pa la rlung nang du bzung nyes pas skyon 'byung ste/ de lta bu la sems sna rtse'am sna bug g.yon du gtad sna g.yas lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mdzub kyis bkag la rlung sna g.yon nas nang du rngubs la phyir gtong zhing ci tsam 'jog thub thub phyir bzhag pa nyid yang yang byed pa zab/ phyir 'jog pa dang nang du 'dzin pa gnyis kas dka' sla'i dbye ba 'byed mi shes pa gang 'dod byung na phyi nang gi rlung bsre thub pa yin pas gegs cher mi 'byung ngo*// spyir bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi ta'i slob ma phyis bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i slob ma yang yin te/ rgyal ba ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan bya ba de bsgom gyi gegs sel ba la de las mkhas pa ma byung*/ khong gi zhal nas/ stong nyid rtogs dang snying rjer ldan// zhen log mos gus nyid dang bzhi// de rnams gang dang ldan kyang phan// de rnams gcig dang mi ldan na// dmigs pa rkyang gis phan pa chung*// zhes dang*/ kha cig khyed la gegs sel gyi yi ge 'dra yod par gda' bas de zhu 'tshal zer ba 'ong gin 'dug ste/ de lta bu yod na bdag gi bla ma rnams la yang yod dgos te med/

des na bdag rang gi dge sbyor nyams su blangs pas/ khams la mtho dman mang po byung ba kun byung rgyal du bskyangs nas skyon sangs nas yon tan skyes/ de la brten nas bdag rang gi dge sbyor nyams su blangs pa'i bogs 'don mdor bsdus 'di yin/ thams cad yon tan brjod bya zhing*// zhum pa med par gzengs bstod la// mi dgag had kyis gtong ba ni// lus kyi gnad du shes par bya// mnyam bzhag bsgom pa'i rjes nyid la// ha dang hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang gsum// gsung gi gdangs dang ldan pa ni// ngag gi gnad du shes par bya// dmigs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas// bying rgod nad gsum bsal bya ste// rig pa rang so 'dzin pa ni// sems kyi gnad du shes par bya// de yi rjes la 'di ltar 'byung*// glang chen chang gis myos pa bzhin// bun ne long nge zing nge ba// ngos bzung med par ngo yis sprad// sdug bsngal thams cad bde bar 'bar// nad dang gdon gyi rtog pa bral// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong*// skyon sangs drin du shes pa na// nyams 'di dang mi 'bral zhes kyang bya// zhes gsungs so// de la bde sdug gi rkyen bzang ngan gang byung yang ngos bzung la lam du btang*/ lus mchong rgyugs 'gro 'dod pa sogs mi 'gegs par had kyis btang ste gang shar byed pa lus gnad/ sems dmigs pa gang rung la ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag rjes hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang ha dang gsum gyi kha sna nas rlung thon che ba byed pa ngag gi gnad/ dmigs pa'i rten sna tshogs la bslab ste lha'i phyag mtshan dang*/ thig le/ yig 'bru sogs la sems 'dzin yang yang kha spos la rtsal sbyong bya ba sems kyi gnad/ gnad gsum po byas rjes sems lhod nas 'jog pa ni rig pa rang so 'dzin pa'o// de la myong tshul snang ba kun rang bzhin med par shes shing*/ zi bun ne ba byung ba ni glang chen chang gis myos pa dang*/ ngo sprod ces pa'i bar gyi don no// tshul 'di lta bu go zhing nyams su myong bar ma byas na gegs sel gyi dpe cha sogs bltas pas phan par dka'/

mi la ras pa sogs la gegs byung dus bla ma la zhu sa ni med/ gzhan la yi ge bskur ba dang gzhan gyis bcos byas pa dang*/ dpe cha klog nas shes pa byung ba ga la yin/ kho rang la nyams bzang po skyes nas byung rgyal du btang bas gegs kyis ma tshugs par yon tan skyes pa yin 'dug go /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi lam ma 'khrul bar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rang byung gi nyams skyes pa de dag ngo ma shes skyong tshul ma mkhas pas gegs su 'gro ba yin no// de la bzhi ste nyon mongs pa rang byung gi ye shes/ rnam rtog rang byung gi ye shes/ snrel zhi rang byung gi ye shes/ gsal zhing yangs la mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes so// 'dir lam la 'bad pas don du gnyer bya mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes yin mod kyi/ de skye bar byed pa la dper na me'i sngon du du ba 'thul ba bzhin/ rang byung gi ye shes gong ma gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ dang po ni/ las rlung rnam rtog gi bzhon par gyur pa de phyi rol du rgyur ma bcug cing*/ nang du drangs nas rlung kha sbyor bsgom pas lte ba man chad kyi rtsa rnams dang*/ khyad par sum mdo drod kyi gnas su rlung sems 'dus pas sdang bas 'dod chags che ba gcig 'byung ste/ de ngo ma shes par lam du khyer ma shes na nyon mongs pa kha khyal nas 'gro ba yin no// ngo shes shing skyon du mi lta bar sngar bzhin bsgom pas/ gnyis pa spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad kyi rtsa nang gi rlung sems ro rkyang gnyis su tshud nas rnam rtog bun long bun long du skye ba 'byung*/ de rnam rtog rang byung gi ye shes su ngo ma shes na dge sbyor gtor nas 'gro ba yin no// ngo shes shing skyon du ma lta bar dga' dung nge ba dang bcas sngar bzhin nyams len drag po byas pas/ gsum pa snrel zhi rang byung gi ye shes skye/ de yang lte ba'i lkog na sngar rlung sems rgyu ma myong pa'i khong stong lta bu'i rtsa yod pa'i nang du rlung sems 'dus nas bsgom shin tu bying ba'i nyams skye ba 'byung*/

de ngos ma zin cing lam du khyer ma shes na bying pa chen po'i gegs su 'gro/ de dag rtsa gnas so sor rlung sems 'dus pa'i nyams su shes par bya/ de yang lus la byung ba thams cad lus kyi nyams su shes par bya/ sems la byung ba thams cad sems kyi nyams su shes par bya/ nyams ci skyes la skyon du mi blta bar cir snang rang sems dang*/ sems sgyu ma dang*/ sgyu ma rten 'brel dang*/ rten 'brel brjod bral du shes par byas te sngar bzhin bsgom pas rlung sems dbu mar tshud nas/ bzhi pa mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes sam/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skye ba yin no// de lta bu'i dpe'i ye shes lam du byas shing bsgom pas mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mthong lam rgyud la skye bar gsungs so// de ltar nyams kyi 'char sgo dang gegs la sogs pa gang zag gcig la yong ba de thams cad la yong ba'i nges pa med de/ sngon gyi las 'phro yod pa dang dbang po rnon po 'ga' zhig la gegs med par yon tan kho na skye ba yang bshad/ 'ga' zhig la gegs byung ba yon tan du shar ba yang srid/ 'ga' zhig la gegs kho na 'byung ba yang yod/ khyad par rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam 'di nyams su bzhes pa'i sngon gyi mkhas grub rnams la gegs chen po byung ba'i lo rgyus mi snang zhing*/ chos rje bla ma dam pas grub chen brag phug pa'i drung du 'di nyid kyi rtsa dbu ma che ba zhus nas zhag gsum nyams myong mthar phyin par mdzad do// spyi don gnyis pa bogs 'don zhar byung du bshad pa la spyir bogs mi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ rje yang dgon pa'i zhal nas 'jig rten blo yis ma thongs shing gnyis snang gi yul la zhen na/ zla ba nyi mas non pa zhig yon tan la bogs mi 'byung bas na/ tshe 'di'i ltos thag rbad kyis bcad/ 'jig rten blos seng nge btang la/ chags sdang rmongs gsum tshe 'dir 'dod blo dang bral tsa na yon tan rong rong skye yin 'dug

rnams legs par phye nas nges pa'i don la 'jug cing lag len bya dgos so// ji skad du/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga'// lung gi gnas skabs mi shes par// mdo rgyud lung sbyor klog pa 'dir mi dgos// dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka med// sangs rgyas sems can yod min sogs// 'di 'dra gsungs pa'i lung rnams kun// lta ba yin gyi bsgom pa dang*// spyod pa gnyis kyi lung ma yin// dbang med pa la dngos grub med// cho ga 'khrugs na las mi chags// log par spyad na ltung ba 'byung*// lha bsgom 'khrul na byin mi rlobs// the tshom za na nyes pa skye// des na cho ga ci byed kyang*// shin tu dag par bya dgos zhes// de 'dra'i lung kun spyod pa dang*// bsgom pa yin gyi lta ba min// gzhan yang lung sbyor byed pa la// 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i gnas skabs rnam gnyis yod// dbang dang dam tshig sdom pa sogs// 'bad nas sgrub par gsungs pa ni// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma brgal ba'i// 'jig rten pa la gsungs pa yin// dbang dang dam tshig sogs mi dgos// phyag dang mchod pa kun las grol// bsam gtan bsgom pa kun spangs te// lam kun gzings bzhin dor bya zhes// gsungs pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// brgal ba'i gang zag rnams la gsungs// de 'dra'i gnas skabs shes nas ni// de dang 'tsham pa'i lung sbyor bya// de 'dra'i rnam bzhag mi shes pa'i// lung sbyor mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas// zhes dang*/

snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du// grags pa'i chos lugs mang du yod// rgyud dang mthun na blang du rung*// min na rdzun gyi sdeb phyogs yin// rmi lam gyi ni chos lugs dang*// zhal mthong gi ni lha la sogs// 'di dag mdo rgyud dang mthun na// blangs kyang skyon du gyur pa med// mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun na// bdud kyi byin rlabs yin zhes bya// bla ma'ang mdo rgyud dang mthun na// de ni bla ma yin par bzung*// sangs rgyas bstan bzhin mi gsung na// bla ma yin yang btang snyoms bzhag /des na rmi lam chos lugs dang*// zhal gzigs pa yi yi dam dang*// lung bstan pa yi sangs rgyas dang*// bla ma'i gsung sgros la sogs pa// ma dpyad par ni bab chol du// tshad ma yin zhes gzung mi bya// 'di 'dra bdud kyi byin rlabs las// 'byung ba srid pa rgyal bas gsungs// des na sangs rgyas bstan pa mchog /nges don tshad ma yin par bzung*// yang na dngos po stobs shugs kyi// rigs pas grub pa tshad mar bzung*// skyes bu rdzun mas sbyar ba yi// mdo rgyud tshad mar bzung mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar dpyad shes dgos so// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo nyams su len pa la gegs sel zhing bogs 'don pa'i man ngag rang gi nyams su myong ba zhig yi ger khod cig ces skyes mchog rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i mchog sprul don grub rgya mtshos lan cig ma yin par bka' stsal 'byor kyang*/ kho bos ni chos bzhin nyams su ma blangs pas/ nyams myong chos nas bshad pa ltar ga la 'byung*/ de lta bu yong du re ba'ang 'khrul pa yin te dper na 'o ma 'dod nas ba yi rwa co nyid rtser gang 'then kyang de las 'o ma mi ster ba bzhin no// kho bo'i nyams len ni dus gsum gyi rnam rtog kho na yin la/ de'i spyod tshul ni thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis rtogs ldan ring mo la gdams par/

khyed da lta'i rtogs ldan ring mo ba// so na ba la'ang lha rjes sman sbyor zhing*// wa smas na'ang rim gro bon yas byed// chang zhim tsa na stong nyid kyi kha sbad can// gtam thos tsa na mngon shes sna tshogs smra// chos bgro tsa na mi smra'i brtul zhugs can// mi blun po tshogs tsa na nga mkhas zer// mtshams gcod dus su gong kha nyin mor gtong*// chos nyan dus su 'dag sbyar chu bug sgo// tshig gzar po re'i rkyen yang mi theg par// chos thams cad mnyam nyid yin no lo// khyed grub thob tha mal du ma shi 'tshal// khyed grub thob ring mo 'dri nan che// nga smra 'dod kyi kha la bzod blag med// gtam mtshang la phog pa ma bzod na// khyed rtogs ldan yin pa'i dam bca' bud// ces gsungs pa dang rang spyod la yod pa gzhir bzhag yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi bka' drin las gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud snying po gsang chen slob bshad kyi chos skor rnams kyis gtsos/ bod yul du byung zhing deng sang bka' ma chad pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa mang du thos shing*/ khyad par slob bshad zab mo 'di la yid ches kyi dad pa thob nas lugs srol 'di nyid kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros man ngag phyogs tsam zhig 'dir bkod pa yin no// e ma ho/ zab don mthar thug rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam bzang kun gyi yang snying gang*// paṇa grub dbang po nā ro ta pa'i bzhed srol 'khrul med sa skya pa'i// mkhas dang grub pa'i bla chen rim byon de dag thugs kyi nor bu mchog /nyams su bstar la nye bar mkho ba'i zab gnad kha cig 'dir bshad do// kha dog dri ros phyug pa'i sbrang rtsi de// bung ba'i kha las byung kyang ke sar li// bcud las gzhan yin de phyir 'dir bkod tshogs// 'khrul zad gong ma'i snyan brgyud zhal gdams yin// tha dad nyams kyi 'char sgor zhen pa'i dug

/rten 'brel zab mo'i 'khrul gyis dbyung byed nyid// phya rgyas re re tsam las zad pa yi// brjod bya rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dpog nus min// nges nges rgyal ba'i bka' dgongs tshad ma'i lam// de de yid ches man ngag la brten nas// yang yang bsgom pas bsgom byung shes rab mig /gsal gsal 'khrungs tshe gegs kun rang sar 'jig /tshig gi sdebs las don gyi brda sprod bzhin// nyams myong la brten nyams kyi bcos tshul yang*// phan tshun 'brel ba'i gnad las gol gyur na// dbul po'i gter bzhin chos kyi dgos nus ci// de ltar na yang deng sang gangs ri'i khrod// shes bya'i gnad la ma 'dris dran dbang dang*// lam zab bsgom myong dben pa'i siddhi sogs// ya mtshan gtam gyi 'byung khungs grangs las 'das// de phyir bdag lta bu zhig smra bcad kyi// brtul zhugs kho nas chog par mi 'dzin par// tsu ta'i gling du rkang gnyis bsgrub pa 'am// gshog pa med par gnam 'phang spyod 'dod 'dra// 'on te mdo khams nor 'dzin yangs pa'i ma// mtho ris klung chen spun zla'i chab gnyis mod// dge bcu'i dpal kun 'du ba'i sman ljongs cher// thub chen rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'dzin pa la// gang gi mtshan yang 'dzam gling mdzes byed kyi// mchog gnyis mkhas pa'i khri la ngal bso ba// dpal ldan zhi ba lha zhes grags pa yi// skyes mchog de yis ring nas bskul ba'i ngor// snyan brgyud bye ba'i gter mdzod rdo rje 'chang*// mtshungs med blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bzhed srol mchog /slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir// bya bral lhag bsam skyong ba gang des sbyar// tshul 'dir nyes pa'i tshang tshing ci mchis pa// bla ma mchog dang ḍā ki'i tshogs rnams kyis// gdod nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// lhan cig bzod pa'i me yis sbyang du gsol// legs byas nam mkha'i nor bu 'od 'bar bas// bdud rigs 'byung po'i bya rnams long gyur cing*// nges gsang bstan pa'i padmo bzhad pa las// rnam grol sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'phel bar shog

/ces zab lam nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma sogs thabs lam bsgom pa'i gegs sel man ngag khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i thugs thig ces bya ba 'di'ang*/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis// 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo/ gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bco lngar/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dus dran gyi nyin/ gdan sa chen po zhwa lu ri phug tu sbyar ba 'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas su gnas par gyur cig dpe 'di khrid ma thob pa dang nyams su mi len pa la mi bstan pa'i bka' rgya dam po yod/ gu hya sa ma ya/ gu hya sa ma ya// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
